findings.finding: The reviewed manifest writer sets versionCode to 4, while Gradle validation, final APK badging and proof require versionCode 5. An ordinary successful aapt2 build reaches a deterministic assertion failure at line141.
findings.recommendation: Set manifest versionCode5, then bind actual packaged badging and EXIT0 to the emitted build proof.

findings.finding: The build terminal receipt is accepted solely for exit_code0; no terminal output or exact build proof digest is checked. A stale unrelated successful receipt can be paired with a separate assertion-bearing proof. The source/current-APK checks do not establish which successful job produced that proof.
findings.recommendation: Builder final stdout should include exact proof digest and existing APK identity/case counts; publisher should parse actual terminal output and compare proof digest, APK path/bytes/SHA and all three case counts. Hash/preserve the actual receipt in publication checkpoint/receipt.

findings.finding: Publisher states min28/target35, three passing host groups and host-only runtime scope, but does not require build.min_API28/target_API35 or all_passed/Android_runtimefalse for all three host groups. HFP preflight case count is not constrained positive.
findings.recommendation: Add fixed metadata checks for min28/target35, each host group's all_passed and Android_runtimefalse, and the agreed HFP count/minimum. Keep these separate from future Android/device runtime evidence.

findings.finding: A read or replacement exception during the first rollback aborts the loop, leaving other written artifacts unrestored and masking the original publication exception.
findings.recommendation: Attempt each eligible reverse restoration in its own try, collect failures, preserve the original exception and write a bounded rollback failure journal. Continue respecting equality guards to avoid overwriting a concurrent editor.

findings.finding: Durable canonical-before snapshot excludes the old APK. Its bytes exist only in process memory for rollback. The six-artifact recovery record is incomplete if the publisher process terminates after replacing the APK.
findings.recommendation: Save the old APK privately with digest, or bind/verify a durable existing old checkpoint artifact path before mutation. Describe exception recovery separately from crash-atomic publication.

findings.finding: Same PID/start is verified before APK HTTP fetch and final artifact readback; final receipt nevertheless records the original server PID with service_not_restartedtrue. A server restart in that later interval is not rechecked.
findings.recommendation: Repeat P.live_server(web)==(pid,start) at the final verification boundary; do not restart the service.

findings.finding: Explicit privacy regex covers HTML only. The inherited checkpoint/history is also serialized into public findings JSON without a corresponding privacy assertion. No actual private-data leak is established by this two-script source-only review.
findings.recommendation: Apply the existing narrow privacy predicate to the serialized public JSON plus HTML, keeping signing credentials/private command receipts out of public records.

preserved_contracts.contract: Requires active imported full objective, incomplete canonical goal, user-away/no audible tests and explicit builtin-WiFi false; no device action performed in this script.
Preserves audio/navigation/microphone/connectivity objects and old Android history; engineering percentages and phases are checked unchanged. No percent rise or native music/AA completion claim.

Plans five canonical artifacts plus one APK; performs actual HTTP equality and file readback on publish path. Imported P helper implementation and crash-atomic behavior remain outside this two-file review.
Records app Java and three host test pins plus manifest/Gradle/builder; rechecks Java/tests/manifest/Gradle after compilation and explicitly marks phone/native audio unverified.

Password file and signing key stay under a private directory and credentials are passed via file arguments; no credential value is printed by these statements. Existing directory/tool contents were not opened in this review.

limitations: No target scripts executed, imported or modified; no Java source/APK/tool manifests/helper code/device/native/canonical content read.
Referenced source-review/public-source-review proofs were still future inputs; their assertions were not treated as current runtime proof.
Source pins refer exactly to the two captured reads, even if root subsequently changes scripts in response to this review.
Findings concern finite build/publication provenance and rollback contracts; no new test suite or expanded target scope requested.
